'''Juri's Sabacc Parlor''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall that specialized in the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card game and was located in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="Gamer3" /> One of Cloud City's most prestigious gambling halls,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|182|Juri's Sabacc Parlor}}</ref> it specifically hosted high-stakes sabacc games and was in business<ref name="Gamer3" /> at some point between [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{GamerCite|3|Cloud Cover}} is set at some point between the events of {{Film|V}} and {{Film|VI}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively.</ref>

Situated in [[Grid 10]] of Cloud City's [[Promenade Level 16]], Juri's Sabacc Parlor was located between the [[Diet/Legends|dining]] establishment [[Well-Done Bantha|The Well-Done Bantha]] and the elite meeting place and [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] establishment known as [[Gale's Central Club]], with the [[Sabacc parlor/Legends|sabacc parlor]] sharing a curved front wall with its neighboring venues. The entrance of Juri's Sabacc Parlor was situated nearly directly opposite the large [[vestix tree]] planted at the center of Grid 10. The front wall of the sabacc parlor was approximately seventeen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] wide, and the interior of the establishment continued at the same width for at least another twenty-eight meters.<ref name="Gamer3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Juri's Sabacc Parlor appeared in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure "[[Cloud Cover]]," authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]], illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]], and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer3" /> on [[April 17]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010316.html|text=''Star Wars Gamer'' #3}}</ref>
